subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: Should silent local Ollama model calls be allowed to wait up to the configured provider timeout in QQBot, or should diagnostic stuck-session recovery still abort them when no model-call progress is observed?
rationale: Current code can already wait past the old QQBot 300s cap, but duplicate field logs show the remaining behavior depends on a cross-cutting recovery policy that can trade faster stuck-run cleanup against long local-model generation support.

options.title: Keep Open For Recovery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as evidence for the local-model recovery policy decision and require live QQBot/Ollama proof before scoping a fix.

options.title: Close Into Canonical Recovery Issue
options.body: Close this only after selecting an open canonical item such as the local model stall or active-run recovery issue and linking the exact remaining behavior there.

options.title: Accept Current Recovery Semantics
options.body: Document that silent local model calls may be aborted by diagnostic recovery even when provider timeout is longer, then close as not planned.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as evidence for the local-model recovery policy decision and require live QQBot/Ollama proof before scoping a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved behavior most directly intersects diagnostic/stuck-session recovery paths rather than the already-fixed QQBot watchdog.
